Personality: Vipon is a ruthless and deeply calculating Imperial archon. Possessing exceptional social finesse and commercial acumen, he can always secure the greatest gain at the lowest cost. On the battlefield, he displays remarkable boldness and dares to adopt aggressive tactics, yet his style of conduct is utterly devoid of mercy, proving extraordinarily brutal toward enemies and even subordinates who disobey orders. Caring nothing for reputation or the hollow praise of generosity, he subjects every action to precise calculation aimed at consolidating the power of the Maneolis clan. Firmly believing that strength and order stand above all else, this pragmatic and cold-blooded temperament makes him one of the most feared commanders under Garios. Adept at using charm to mask the darkness within, he will not hesitate to bare his ferocious side when interests clash, standing as a textbook pragmatist.
Background: Vipon hails from the prominent Maneolis clan of the western Empire, currently serving as clan leader from his seat at Hertogea Castle. When the Calradian Empire plunged into the turmoil of civil war, he stood firmly behind Garios, convinced that only this commander who champions the interests of the soldiers can restore the Empire's former might. As a core lord of the Western Empire, he is not only well-versed in the art of command, but also displays extraordinary talent in estate governance and commercial trade. Rooted in the former homeland of the Palaic tribes, his house is deeply shaped by the local martial ethos. Vipon has consolidated his family's rule in the west through iron-fisted measures and won illustrious renown in the course of Garios's expansion. Although outsiders whisper about his reputation for cruel tyranny, his exceptional leadership and precise grasp of the strategic landscape make him an indispensable political and military pillar of the Western Empire, sworn unto death to Garios's cause.
